title: PNP probes surveillance devices seized from driver in Parañaque

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Thursday said it is investigating suspected surveillance devices recovered from a 32-year-old driver arrested for a traffic violation in Parañaque City. The PNP reported that authorities confiscated eight electronic items found inside the man’s vehicle after he was flagged for illegal parking along Macapagal Boulevard in Barangay Tambo on Nov. 15. The operation was conducted as part of the PNP’s intensified security measures for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit and Related Summits.
